newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending 33-month high.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending 33-month high.

text.p: Polish shares were seen setting their seventh 33-month high this month, as continued growth by large-cap stocks reflected increased buying by foreign investors acting on their picks for 1997, analysts said.

They said the market would apparently continue to be unaffected by the central bank's warning it might raise interest rates to curb fast credit growth, with the bank having signalled it would put the decision off for another month.
Analysts said the next major signal for the bourse would be firms' December earnings results, the bulk of which are due on Monday.
